# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/dppereyra/rfab-proxy/security/advisories/new)
rather than in a public issue.

If you can't use GitHub, email **mail@dppereyra.com** with the subject
`[SECURITY] rfab-proxy vulnerability report`.

### Guidelines

- Include clear reproduction steps and the affected versions.
- Do **not** disclose details publicly until a fix is released.
- Responsible disclosure is appreciated and credited.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| latest (master) | ✅ |
| older releases | ⚙️ Patches on a case-by-case basis |
